result.title: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
result.summary: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. SOC-Net projects an affine lifting of the backbone output onto the reachable slice of a fixed product of Lorentz cones and maps the correction back to the output space. For separable constraints, this projection splits into one projection per cone, and each is available in closed form or reduces to a single scalar equation, regardless of the cone dimension. We prove that SOC-Net retains the expressive power of the backbone network under regularity conditions and accommodates end-to-end training by standard backpropagation with an explicit Jacobian. Experiments on contact force allocation with friction constraints and 3-D obstacle avoidance with an input-robust CBF demonstrate that SOC-Net satisfies the constraints at every evaluated input, with lower evaluation latency than the tested solver-based and iterative baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SOC-Net：把骨干网络输出的仿射提升投影到固定 Lorentz 锥乘积的可达切片上，使输出对任意输入按构造满足二阶锥约束，并给出可分离情形的闭式或单标量方程求解与显式雅可比，用于摩擦锥力分配和基于 CBF 的避障。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按构造投影到可行集、无需迭代求解」的思路，可能为把 latent 推理状态约束到可容许区域（如几何或安全可行集）提供问题表述上的借鉴，但论文面向控制约束满足，与视觉推理的关联尚待核查。
